checks.claim: Creators can sign up with Google or an email address.
Creators verify their email, then provide their name, website and plan choice; they can start on Free.
Students can submit text or video through a personalised form without an account or special software; Senja describes this as taking about 30 seconds.
Creators create a form from an example or template, including course templates, and save changes before switching tabs.
Setting a question to Video requires students to record or upload a video; Video and text lets them choose one format.
Students must answer every displayed question and provide their name; creators control whether other About you fields are required.
The consent page is enabled by default and lets students choose public or private use.
Creators can distribute the form by copying its link from the Share window or Forms page.
After submission, students see the Thank you & word of mouth page.
